desc: 加绒保暖螺纹收口、四色可选，外出内搭皆宜的童装卫衣两件套

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼看清整套形态，干净合规赢点击
一秒传达加绒保暖这一核心利益，承接点击
放大换季单层薄衣不挡凉的焦虑，引出加绒方案
让家长代入孩子户外出游的真实穿着场景
用螺纹领口与袖口的针路细节证明做工亲肤
用尺码结构与空白表格消除选码疑虑
同框并列四色让买家一次选对颜色
以折叠工艺细节与空白洗护图标位降低购买风险
以两色并列与空价签按钮收口促单

style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots, cloud-blue #AFCBE8 and mist-grey #E9E6E0 panels for info and scene shots, deep indigo #4A72B8 only for the closing shot
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons in the single indigo accent #4A72B8
style.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft kids-fashion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm white #FDFBF7, cloud blue #AFCBE8, mist grey #E9E6E0 and one indigo accent #4A72B8; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows; rounded geometric sans-serif; consistent thin-line icon style in the single indigo accent; clean kids-fashion photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and consistent garment scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero garment angle and consistent scale for the two-piece set across the whole suite
style.surfaceSystem: matte light-grey textile board and soft pine-wood surface for flat lays
